_meta: Training provenance for the LoRA adapters, keyed by adapter version FAMILY. Each entry is the dev-time chain that PRODUCED the adapter weights (Sonnet gold corpus -> format to chat JSONL -> LoRA fine-tune), shown left-of the gold adapter node in the diagram. These are DETERMINISTIC recorded facts (not LLM-generated). The renderer resolves an adapter name like 'adapter-v2a-e2' to a family by normalising dashes->underscores and matching 'v2b'/'v2a' substrings, else v1.
